subject: problem loading shiny when calling it from ggvis

messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: problem loading shiny when calling it from ggvis
parts:
I tried running code from the interactions section in http://ggvis.rstudio.com/ggvis-basics.html and for some reason the install of shiny doesnt map right to the local dir of the package which in my computer is by default

C:\Users\yoni\Documents\R\win-library\3.1\ggvis\www\ggvis

how do i change the path the package looks for?

> mtcars %>% 
+     ggvis(~wt, ~mpg, 
+           size := input_slider(10, 100),
+           opacity := input_slider(0, 1)
+     ) %>% 
+     layer_points()
Loading required package: shiny
Showing dynamic visualisation. Press Escape/Ctrl + C to stop.
Error in normalizePath(path.expand(path), winslash, mustWork) : 
  path[1]="d:/RCompile/CRANpkg/lib/3.1/ggvis/www/ggvis": The system cannot find the path specified

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: problem loading shiny when calling it from ggvis
parts:
Hi Yoni,

That was a bug that slipped through our QA process. It's fixed in
0.3.0.1 which is available for windows on CRAN, so try downloading
again.

Hadley
